messages.author: Matthew Guberman-Pfeffer
messages.body:
Dear Amber Community,
Cmake reports that my version of CUDA and GCC are not compatible, but if I look at cmake/CudaConfig.cmake (lines 83 to 108) I see no if-statement that would permit a CUDA version higher than 11.6 (I have 11.7). Does Amber22 not work with coda 11.7? If so, what should I do?
I have gcc-9, gcc-10, and gcc-11 available on this computer (assuming I installed the later two correctly.)
Help is very, very much appreciated!
Thank you in advance.
Best,
Matthew

messages.author: Todd Minehardt
messages.body:
Matthew,
You should update your CUDA version to 12.3 (latest) and edit a few files
in a few of the cmake files as detailed here
http://archive.ambermd.org/202311/0058.html
.
I'm running Ubuntu 22.04 LTS with CUDA 12.3, AmberTools23, gcc 11.4 (don't
go higher than 11.x for gcc) and everything works as expected.
Cheers,
Todd
